title: How to Check Gold Purity With HUID: BIS Hallmark Marks and the BIS Care App
seoTitle: How to Check HUID Number on Gold: BIS Care App Guide
seoDescription: Check a HUID number in the BIS Care app, read the three hallmark marks, see the karat-to-fineness table and know your compensation rights under BIS rules.
excerpt: What each of the three hallmark marks means, a karat-to-fineness table, the limits of an app lookup, and what BIS rules let you claim if a wedding-season purchase turns out less pure than marked.
